vetSays.line: 🛡️ Kurt, Colin, Leo, Raj and Meera met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Kurt, Colin, Leo, Raj, Meera are hurt.
🛡️ Leo, Raj, Jorge, Ingrid and Aria met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Leo, Raj, Jorge, Ingrid, Aria are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Raj, Jorge, Ingrid and Aria met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Raj, Ingrid, Aria are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Lulwa, Leo, Meera, Ingrid and Aria met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Meera, Ingrid are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Leo SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. Its focus shatters. The The Scarred Old Croaker freezes. (stunned)
The Scarred Old Croaker is still frozen from your scream.

regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
